note: R, the tolerance release F is verified against: the one published artifact whose runtime is an independent older peer, so a second build of this tree cannot stand in for it. `integrity` (sha512) and `shasum` (sha1) are the registry's numbers for the packed tarball, recorded from `npm view @panphora/clayjs@1.16.0 dist --json`; the gate hashes the cached tarball against both before it loads it. `extracted.sha512` is the digest of the extracted tree the gate imports, so .version-cache/1.16.0/ is proved to be the tree those numbers were recorded from. Never edit the cache.
